_comment: What scripts/build-sw.py needs to know about this course. The generator
is the same file in all seven repositories on shamsfelfel.github.io;
everything that differs between them is here. See the header of
precache is read in order and the last matching rule wins, as in a
.gitignore, over the list git gives for this repository.
note:
Every page, stylesheet, script, question bank and icon the course is
made of, precached on install. Offline is the claim this course makes
on its own home page, so it is the whole file list or nothing.
